article_title: Why does Australia want Brits to swap Sydney for the outback?

tasks.prompt: Why does the Australian government want to revisit special visa treatment for British backpackers?
options: Too many British visitors are choosing regional farm work
Britons are no longer eligible for working holiday visas
The UK has ended tariff-free trade with Australia
The exemption encourages many Britons to remain in big cities while regional employers lack workers
tasks.correct_answer: The exemption encourages many Britons to remain in big cities while regional employers lack workers
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הפטור מעבודה אזורית מאפשר לבריטים להישאר בערים הגדולות, בזמן שעסקים וחקלאים באזורים מרוחקים מדווחים על מחסור בעובדים.

tasks.prompt: What change did the UK-Australia trade deal make for British working holidaymakers?
options: It exempted them from regional work needed to stay beyond one year
It limited them to jobs in agriculture and fisheries
It reduced their maximum age from 35 to 30
It required them to live in Cairns for three years
tasks.correct_answer: It exempted them from regional work needed to stay beyond one year
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ההסכם פטר בריטים מן הדרישה למצוא עבודה אזורית או מרוחקת כדי להאריך את שהותם מעבר לשנה.

tasks.prompt: How did the number of backpacker visas issued to Britons change from 2023-24 to 2025-26?
options: It fell from 77,000 to 47,200
It rose from 47,200 to just over 77,000
It stayed at approximately 52,000
It increased from 11,000 to 20,000
tasks.correct_answer: It rose from 47,200 to just over 77,000
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי נתוני הממשלה האוסטרלית, המספר עלה מ־47,200 ליותר מ־77,000.

tasks.prompt: What does the article mean when it says the free trade agreement is “not set in stone”?
options: It applies only to the construction industry
It will expire automatically next month
It cannot be discussed by the two prime ministers
It can be adjusted when there are sound policy reasons
tasks.correct_answer: It can be adjusted when there are sound policy reasons
tasks.explanation_hebrew: not set in stone פירושו שאינו קבוע ובלתי ניתן לשינוי; ניתן לבצע בהסכם התאמות.

tasks.prompt: What must most non-British working holidaymakers do to qualify for a second-year extension?
options: Complete at least 88 days of specified regional work
Pay a special tourism tariff
Win one of 5,000 third-year places first
Work for six months in Sydney hospitality
tasks.correct_answer: Complete at least 88 days of specified regional work
tasks.explanation_hebrew: עבור אזרחי מדינות אחרות נדרשים לפחות 88 ימי עבודה אזורית מוגדרת כדי לזכות בשנה שנייה.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “bucking the trend” describe about Paige Tomlinson?
options: She is campaigning to abolish all regional visas
She left Australia after only a few days
She chose to live and work in Cairns while many Britons favour Sydney
She works only during the avocado harvest
tasks.correct_answer: She chose to live and work in Cairns while many Britons favour Sydney
tasks.explanation_hebrew: bucking the trend פירושו לפעול בניגוד למגמה; פייג׳ בחרה בקיירנס האזורית ולא בסידני.

tasks.prompt: Why do regional tourism and hospitality businesses view British backpackers as both workers and customers?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את התרומה הכפולה: כוח עבודה עונתי והוצאה כספית כתיירים.
expected_points: Backpackers fill temporary and seasonal jobs in hospitality and tourism
They also spend money on accommodation, food, travel and local attractions
Both labour and visitor spending support regional economies such as Far North Queensland

tasks.prompt: Summarise the policy tension between regional labour needs and Australia's broader migration-reduction plans.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג הן את צורכי החקלאות והאזורים והן את ההצעות לצמצם הארכות אשרה.
expected_points: Regional employers and farmers say they need backpackers for seasonal labour
Backpackers account for one in seven farm jobs and about 52,000 work in horticulture each year
The government also plans to reduce net migration under political pressure
Proposed ballots would cap second-year extensions at 45,000 and third-year stays at 5,000
Farm representatives argue those wider caps could deepen labour shortages

tasks.prompt: How do the figures from Cairns businesses support the claim that the rule change altered where British backpackers work?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להשתמש בלפחות שני נתונים מהכתבה ולהסביר כיצד הם מצביעים על ירידה אזורית.
expected_points: Young Britons living and working in the region fell from about 20,000 to about 11,000
At one restaurant group, British staff fell from roughly 25 to five
A hostel chain says French guests now outnumber British guests three to one
The declines occurred after the regional-work exemption began

tasks.prompt: Write an evidence-based paragraph assessing one argument for and one argument against restoring regional-work requirements for Britons.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג טיעון בעד וטיעון נגד הנשענים על פרטים מן הכתבה, ולסיים בהערכה מאוזנת.
expected_points: A supporting argument is that regional farms, tourism and hospitality businesses need seasonal workers
The requirement could spread travellers and spending beyond Sydney and enrich their experience
An opposing argument is that the trade deal grants Britons flexibility and helped visa numbers grow
The response should distinguish labour-market needs from the wider migration-cap debate
